profile.headline: Software Developer at MAPMECHANICS
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm an IT professional with more than 20 years of experience in software development, technical consultancy, system implementation and technical support. During that time I've worked with a broad range of platforms and technologies including the Microsoft .NET Framework, IBM iSeries, SQL Server, Oracle and Microsoft Office. 

Clients like working with me because I have a calm, professional and personable manner, and because I work diligently to deliver quality products.

Specialties:
Web application development using Microsoft ASP.NET 
C# development
System Implementation
Database development for SQL Server and Oracle.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Development of Transport Logistics software products for Windows and Web, using the .NET framework.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Ongoing development of a B2B web portal for a leading client in the Telecoms industry, using a service oriented solution with ASP.NET UI, Oracle 11g backend and Windows Communication Foundation services for transaction processing.

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
.NET 4.0, Access VBA and T-SQL development in support of Contingent Worker Case Management application. 
Performed system analysis and redesigned inefficient processes to leverage .NET technology leading to greatly improved system performance. 
Designed new modules which added greater automation to the workflow, thus greatly reducing the manual effort required by the business.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description: Developed reporting and functional enhancements, browser and Microsoft Office plugins for Transperfect's proprietary project lifecycle management application utilizing ASP.NET 2.0/4.0, C#, T-SQL (SQL Server 2005/2008) and JavaScript.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description: Technical consultancy and .NET 4.0 development provided to clients on an ad hoc basis.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Web application development and support using ASP.NET 2.0/3.5, Oracle PL/SQL, T-SQL.
SOAP web service development using .NET to interface to systems used by customer service and engineering departments.
Developed schedule feeds for external transit agencies (Google, Trips123 etc.) according to their formatting specifications.

positions.title: Technical Consultant (Contract)
positions.description:
Provided software consultancy services to various international banks on behalf of Misys Banking Systems.

Performed systems analysis, designed and developed data migration and system upgrade utilities as required using RPG and OS400.

positions.title: Back Office Systems Developer
positions.description:
Developed enhancements for the company's in-house TREATS treasury system using RPG & OS400.
Acted as principal back-office resource during NY implementation of a new messaging based front office trade feed and oversaw successful system cutover.

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Developed enhancements to the MIDAS treasury system using RPG and OS400. 
Worked on several MIDAS implementations as both technical lead and developer performing data migrations, custom development and issue resolution.
Provided first and second level support for MIDAS.
